value.rationale: The canonical P4-free labelled graph family gives a motivated Fourier recoverability question. The exact six-vertex extra kernel is classified by two natural graph orbits rather than arbitrary character indices, and a low-degree 2-adic moment law proves its absence at seven vertices. The theorem supplies a nontrivial finite boundary and a compact congruence certificate; its value does not depend on an unsupported all-order generalization.
